headline: Om Freight Forwarders releases Q2 financial results
hook: Om Freight reports September quarter performance
summary: Om Freight Forwarders Limited has officially filed its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company submitted the details via a press release to the National Stock Exchange. This filing provides the latest performance data for the logistics firm. Retail investors can access these figures to evaluate the company's recent operational and financial health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly performance data helps assess the company's current financial stability.
